channel.title: Cooking Buddies
channel.desc: As Buddy and Conker decorate their kitchen den for Christmas, they get a call from Meesha Garbett - a two-time World Champion street dancer. Meesha needs Buddy?s help with a dessert that she can make for her family this Christmas, and she will give him a street dance lesson in return! Buddy knows exactly the right thing to make - a rocky road filled with all the favourite biscuits, fruit and nuts around at this time of year, all broken up into gorgeous molten chocolate. Set in a round bowl with melted white chocolate looking like the cream on top, it?s a real Christmas pudding show-stopper, with options to make it your own! To make it really Christmassy, they make their very own ginger nut biscuits to go inside that can also be given as presents to their family. Meesha teaches Buddy a special street dance routine that will get us all rocking around the Christmas tree this Christmas.
